name: Floating Chat Channel Button
author: Nitin Monga

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to add a customizable floating button to your WordPress site that links to your preferred communication channel.

Features:
– Supports any public channel link
– Lightweight and easy setup
– Floating chat icon
– Admin settings for channel URL

Credits

Developed by Tutorials by Nitin – https://tutorialsbynitin.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via the WordPress admin panel or extract into /wp-content/plugins/floating-chat-channel-button/
  2. Activate via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Channel Button
  4. Enter your messaging or broadcast channel URL
  5. Save changes and enjoy!
sections.faq:
Can I link to any platform?

Yes! Use links from any messaging or chat platforms (e.g., Telegram, WhatsApp, Messenger).

Can I change the icon or position?

You can modify the CSS file to customize the button appearance.

Does this plugin support shortcode?

No, this version uses a floating global button only.
